environment: Windows desktop Chromium in-app browser; real browser mouse drags; 390 × 844 CSS-pixel responsive emulation, not a physical phone

automatedTests.compatibility: Frozen v0.7.0–v0.12.0 canonical audio conversions; schema 11 and storage keys unchanged
automatedTests.scope: Atomic group edits, strict insertion and paste, time collisions independent of pitch, bar/phrase/pitch bounds, dynamics, copy independence, inverse restoration, 200 sequential attempts, actual-semitone rectangle selection, audio-start clock, dual-rate PCM reference, preview cancellation, 32-bar WAV and independent stereo MP3 decoding

browser.library: 15 existing works retained; one newly saved edited work, total 16
browser.views: Single-bar grid and phrase view switch without changing the shared snapshot; view preference survives reload; drums retain legacy grid; bass supports phrase editing
browser.keyboard: Enter adds at current write cursor; ArrowUp changes its pitch before insertion; actual label confirms intended pitch and step
browser.clipboard: Two notes copied from first half and pasted into last half with exact matching bars; bass paste retains relative pitch ID and plays in bass register; conflicting paste is rejected
browser.undoRedo: One paste is exactly reversible in one undo and one redo, checked by share URL equality
browser.preservation: All backing tracks preserved after melody paste; schema remains 11; group selection survives pitch and duration edits
browser.mouse: Actual browser horizontal drag moves onset by one snapped step; vertical drag changes pitch; right-handle drag changes duration; overlapping resize rejects and retains the prior note; blank-area rectangle selects both intersected notes
browser.audition: Four-voice audition starts/stops; playback line becomes visible after audio starts and advances; note edits stop audition
browser.persistence: Edited theme shortened to three-step notes and shifted by one step, expanded by repeat to 32 bars, saved and reloaded; own share reopens exactly
browser.exports: Full 32-bar MP3 and WAV generated with expected names; export cancellation plus undo of a temporary pitch drag leaves the saved shared snapshot identical

responsive.internalScrollTest: Horizontal scroll reaches 188 px while pitch-label left remains 40 px; page has no horizontal overflow
responsive.controls: Selection, batch velocity and toolbar controls usable; page scroll reaches all controls; native touch branch separately unit tested

limits: Only current four-bar melody or bass phrase
Monophonic notes and no cross-bar sustains
Clipboard and selection are page-local transient state
Physical-phone and multi-browser long-piece performance unverified
